title: tenshi · Tonight
description: One night in tenshi, live from Tiger Data.

list.name: session
list.label: Night
list.query: SELECT user_name || ' (' || to_char(armed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto', 'Mon DD HH24:MI') || ')' AS __text, id::text AS __value FROM sessions ORDER BY armed_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: The escalation level the server is at for this night.

targets.rawSql: SELECT level AS value FROM sessions WHERE id = '$session'
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM coalesce(resolved_at, now()) - armed_at) AS value FROM sessions WHERE id = '$session'

panels.description: Running count of check-ins answered, from the phone or the Switch.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, count(*) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS value FROM events WHERE session_id = '$session' AND kind = 'checkin_ack' ORDER BY time

panels.description: How fast check-ins get answered. Slower replies make the next check-in come sooner.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, avg(value) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS value FROM metrics WHERE session_id = '$session' AND metric = 'reply_s' ORDER BY time

panels.title: Where she is
panels.description: Heartbeat locations (purple) and the last known one (red), the same point the contact gets.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, lat AS latitude, lng AS longitude FROM events WHERE session_id = '$session' AND lat IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 400
SELECT time, lat AS latitude, lng AS longitude FROM events WHERE session_id = '$session' AND lat IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT time, value FROM metrics WHERE session_id = '$session' AND metric = 'battery_pct' ORDER BY time

panels.description: Times the phone heard a plea for help or aggression and alerted the contact at once.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE session_id = '$session' AND kind = 'danger_alert'

panels.description: Temperature from the Switch. Blue at 5°C or colder.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, value FROM metrics WHERE session_id = '$session' AND metric = 'temp_c' ORDER BY time

panels.title: Escalation ladder
panels.description: Armed, check-in, alarm, contact, backup: each step's timer runs on the server.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, detail->>'to' AS "level" FROM events WHERE session_id = '$session' AND kind = 'level_change' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Sound around her
panels.description: Loudness only, never audio. The red band is where shouting starts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('5 seconds', time) AS time, avg(value) AS "average", max(value) AS "peak" FROM metrics WHERE session_id = '$session' AND metric IN ('sound_db', 'sound_peak_db') AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time, value FROM metrics WHERE session_id = '$session' AND metric = 'sound_db' ORDER BY time
SELECT time, max(value) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS value FROM metrics WHERE session_id = '$session' AND metric = 'sound_peak_db' ORDER BY time
SELECT time, value FROM metrics WHERE session_id = '$session' AND metric = 'movement' ORDER BY time

panels.description: Each one is a row in Tiger Data: location, battery and sound level from her phone.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, count(*) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS value FROM events WHERE session_id = '$session' AND kind = 'heartbeat' ORDER BY time

panels.title: Movement
panels.description: From the phone's motion sensor. Dancing spikes, a still phone flatlines.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('5 seconds', time) AS time, avg(value) AS "movement" FROM metrics WHERE session_id = '$session' AND metric = 'movement' AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Battery
panels.description: Under 20% the check-ins come sooner: a dead phone looks like silence.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, value AS "battery" FROM metrics WHERE session_id = '$session' AND metric = 'battery_pct' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Sound anomaly (z-score)
panels.description: Each reading against its own rolling baseline (SQL window functions). Above 2 is unusual for this night.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, (value - avg(value) OVER w) / NULLIF(stddev_samp(value) OVER w, 0) AS "z-score" FROM metrics WHERE session_id = '$session' AND metric = 'sound_db' AND $__timeFilter(time) WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Per-minute rollup (continuous aggregate)
panels.description: metrics_1m is a TimescaleDB continuous aggregate: minute averages kept fresh in the background.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, max(avg) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'sound_db') AS "Sound (dB)", max(avg) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'movement') AS "Movement", max(avg) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'battery_pct') AS "Battery (%)" FROM metrics_1m WHERE session_id = '$session' AND metric IN ('sound_db', 'movement', 'battery_pct') AND $__timeFilter(bucket) GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE session_id = '$session' AND kind = 'checkin_sent'
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE session_id = '$session' AND kind = 'checkin_ack'
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE session_id = '$session' AND kind = 'level_change' AND detail->>'to' = 'ALARM'

panels.title: How she checked in
panels.description: One tap on the phone, or a touch on the Switch without unlocking it.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'Phone' AS "via", greatest(0, (SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE session_id = '$session' AND kind = 'checkin_ack') - (SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE session_id = '$session' AND kind = 'device' AND detail->>'type' = 'touch')) AS "check-ins" UNION ALL SELECT 'Switch', (SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE session_id = '$session' AND kind = 'device' AND detail->>'type' = 'touch')

panels.title: Danger checks
panels.description: Each dot is a check of what the phone heard. Above the line alerts the contact.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, value AS "score" FROM metrics WHERE session_id = '$session' AND metric = 'distress_score' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Temperature from the Switch
panels.description: Blue below 5°C: likely outside in the cold.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, value AS "temperature" FROM metrics WHERE session_id = '$session' AND metric = 'temp_c' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

SELECT time AS "Time", CASE kind WHEN 'checkin_sent' THEN 'Check-in sent' WHEN 'checkin_ack' THEN 'Checked in' WHEN 'stand_down' THEN 'PIN cancelled the alarm' WHEN 'contact_ack' THEN 'Contact is on it' WHEN 'danger_alert' THEN 'Danger heard, contact alerted' WHEN 'distress_check' THEN 'Danger check' WHEN 'level_change' THEN 'Level: ' || initcap(detail->>'to') WHEN 'device' THEN 'Switch: ' || coalesce(detail->>'type', '') WHEN 'resolved' THEN 'Night ended' ELSE kind END AS "What", CASE WHEN kind IN ('danger_alert') OR detail->>'to' IN ('ALARM', 'CONTACT', 'WIDER') THEN 'alert' WHEN kind IN ('checkin_ack', 'stand_down', 'contact_ack', 'resolved') THEN 'ok' WHEN kind = 'checkin_sent' OR detail->>'to' = 'NUDGE' THEN 'waiting' ELSE 'info' END AS "Kind" FROM events WHERE session_id = '$session' AND kind NOT IN ('heartbeat', 'summary') AND NOT (kind = 'device' AND detail->>'type' = 'reading') AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 40
